svg.title: How existing subscriptions meet the new groups
svg.desc: Left, the existing environment with its existing subscriptions, which keeps running. Right, the new landing zone hierarchy built beside it in the same Microsoft Entra tenant: an intermediate root management group above two groups of landing zones. The duplicate landing zones, Corp and Online, have policy assignments copied and set to audit only. The landing zones Corp and Online have policies as designed. Below them, the Decommissioned group and the Platform group. Arrow 1 leads from the existing environment to the duplicate groups: new subscriptions that hold migrated workloads go in and are only audited; for existing subscriptions, confirm with your platform team. A Sandboxes group sits below the intermediate root. Arrow 2 leads from each duplicate group to the matching real group: the subscription moves when compliance is in the required state. Arrow 3 leads from the existing subscriptions to Decommissioned: cancel the old subscription eventually.
svg.text: How existing subscriptions meet the new groups
The recommended approach: build beside, test in audit-only copies, then move in.
Built beside the old setup, in the same Microsoft Entra tenant
Read the arrows in this order
New subscriptions that hold migrated workloads go into the duplicates (confirm for existing ones). They only audit.
When a team's policy compliance is in the required state, its subscription moves to the matching group.
Eventually, cancel the old subscription and place it in the Decommissioned group.
